basic_info.description: Special 1 Bedroom 1 Bath condo in boutique South Beach building. This property was inspired by its prime position on the famous San Francisco Embarcadero Waterfront and showcases edgy chic city views combined with peeks of the Bay and natural light through the unique curvilinear windows! The home has recently been enhanced with gorgeous wide plank hardwood flooring that add glamour and refinement. Incredible layout with access to the bathroom through the entry/hallway as well as the bedroom. European style kitchen with elegant white countertops and cabinetry and stainless-steel appliances. Wonderful amenities at THE PORTSIDE include optional parking (with an additional fee), extra storage, 2 gyms, a pool and a spa overlooking the Embarcadero. Close to Oracle Park, South Park, Chase Center, The Embarcadero, Ferry Building, Financial District, Caltrain, MUNI, Freeway entrances, The Bay Bridge, Blue Bottle Coffee, grocery stores and several restaurants. Experience this iconic address in SF!
